🎬Rockstar❤️
Rockstar is not just a love story - it's the journey of pain turning into passion. Directed by Imtiaz Ali, the film follows Jordan, played by Ranbir Kapoor, a simple boy who believes true art is born from heartbreak.
What starts as a chaotic college romance slowly becomes an emotional storm of love, separation, fame, and loneliness. Heer, played by Nargis Fakhri, becomes the soul of Jordan's music and madness. Unlike typical romantic films, Rockstar shows how love can heal and destroy someone at the same time.
The movie became unforgettable because of its raw emotions, deep dialogues, magical music by A. R. Rahman, and Ranbir Kapoor's career-defining performance. Every song feels like a memory you never lived but somehow still miss.

Why She Will Never Understand Why You Love Spider-Man.

Tony Stark was born rich. Thor was born a god. Steve Rogers was chosen.

Peter Parker was just a broke kid from Queens who lost his uncle.

He fails constantly. Loses the girl. Can’t pay rent. Can’t tell anyone the truth.

He carries every death silently. He shows up when it costs him everything. He gets called a menace for saving the city.

The mask isn’t a costume. It’s the only place he gets to be his best self.

We met without a plan, without expectations, without knowing what this would become. And somehow, within a few days, you started feeling like someone I had known much longer…

Maybe that’s what happens when you stop trying to control the timing of your life. You just meet someone. You feel something. And for once, you don’t question it. Maybe it was too fast. Maybe it doesn’t make sense on paper.
But not everything meaningful is supposed to.

None of this was by accident✨

🎬 The Good Dinosaur
Animation • Adventure • Emotional

📅 Release
2015

📖 Storyline
Arlo is a young dinosaur who’s afraid of almost everything…

Until tragedy separates him from his family.

Lost far from home, Arlo meets a mysterious human boy named Spot.

What begins as an unlikely friendship becomes a journey through the wilderness as they help each other survive and find their way home.

One is a dinosaur.

One is a human.

And somehow…

They become family. 🦕❤️

🎭 Main Cast
• Arlo 🦕
• Spot 👦
• Butch 🦖
• Momma 🥹
• Poppa ❤️

🏆 Why It Hits Different
It’s not just about dinosaurs.

It’s about grief.

Fear.

Growing up.

And learning that sometimes the people who enter your life unexpectedly can change it forever.

⭐ The Nostalgia
The beautiful landscapes.

The emotional soundtrack.

Spot and Arlo’s friendship.

And that heartbreaking feeling of watching it as a kid…

Only to realize years later just how emotional the story really was. 🥹❤️

🎬Paterson

Paterson follows a quiet bus driver and aspiring poet named Paterson, who lives a simple life in the city of Paterson, New Jersey. Every day, he follows the same routine-driving his bus, writing poetry in his notebook, walking his dog, and having a drink at the local bar.

While his life may seem ordinary, Paterson finds beauty in the smallest moments around him. The film is a gentle meditation on creativity, love, routine, and the quiet poetry of everyday life. Rather than chasing grand ambitions or dramatic events, Paterson reminds us that there can be something deeply meaningful in simply paying attention to the world around us.
